# Works everywhere. Installs everything. You're welcome. 🦞

$ `powershell -c "irm  | iex"`

# Install OpenClaw

$ `npm i -g openclaw`

# Meet your lobster

$ `openclaw onboard`

# For those who read source code for fun [...] OpenClaw software is completely free and open-source (MIT license). Your costs come from AI model APIs: light use runs $10-30/month, typical use $30-70/month, heavy automation can reach $100-150/month or more. You can reduce costs by using local models via Ollama, or use the Brave Search free tier (2,000 requests/month) for web search.
